My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
In great haste, I enclose [£10](/topic/102) for this half year’s Thorne

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Charlton SE and postmarked Winchester 13 July and London SE 15 July 1863.
